description: This file defines React components for displaying progress, projects, and related stats in a dashboard, including subcomponents like ProgressLane, ShowAllButton, CardSkeleton, and StatsCard.

classes.name: ProgressLane
classes.description: A React component that renders a lane of progress or bookmarks with loading and empty states.

classes.name: ShowAllButton
classes.description: A button component to toggle showing all or fewer items in a list.

classes.name: CardSkeleton
classes.description: A placeholder skeleton component for loading states.

classes.name: StatsCard
classes.description: A component to display a statistic with a title and value, with loading state.

methods.name: ProgressStack
methods.description: Main component that displays user progress, projects, and stats in a dashboard layout.
